Package com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.core.bus

Class EventBus

java.lang.Object
com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.core.bus.EventBus
public class EventBus extends Object
A minimal, thread-safe publish/subscribe event bus.

The update pipeline decouples its producers (periodic and asynchronous checks, download progress) from its consumers (the auto-download/install subscriber and the UI presenter) through this bus. Subscribers register for an exact event type; publish(Object) delivers synchronously on the calling thread to every consumer registered for that event's runtime class, so a consumer that needs the event dispatch thread hops onto it itself (as UpdatePresenter does).

This class replaces the host application's shared bus: the module owns a private instance unless a host injects one, and shutdown() releases every subscription once the owner is done with it.

Since:
1.0.0
